description:
Introducing the Heritage Bicycles Jane - a beautiful, handcrafted bicycle designed to elevate your riding experience. The Jane features a classic, vintage-inspired design that seamlessly blends form and function. Its elegant steel frame, handmade in Chicago, is both durable and lightweight, providing a smooth and comfortable ride.

Equipped with high-quality components, the Jane is perfect for both commuting and leisurely rides. The Shimano 8-speed drivetrain ensures smooth and easy shifting, while the Tektro mechanical disc brakes provide reliable stopping power in all weather conditions. The wide, swept-back handlebars and plush leather saddle offer a comfortable, upright riding position, making the Jane ideal for longer rides.

But the Heritage Bicycles Jane isn't just functional - it's also a work of art. Its beautiful design is complemented by thoughtful details such as the custom engraved brass headbadge and the hand-painted pinstriping. Each bike is made to order, allowing you to customize your Jane with your choice of frame color, component upgrades, and even personalized hand-painted accents.
Whether you're commuting to work or cruising through the park, the Heritage Bicycles Jane is a stylish and practical choice for any rider. With its timeless design, high-quality components, and attention to detail, the Jane is sure to become a cherished part of your cycling journey.

Donning either petticoat or rainsuit, the Jane gracefully bridges the gap between the style-first cruiser and everyday commuter.

THE CLASSIC STEP-THROUGH DESIGN EVOKES ELEGANCE, ALL THE WHILE MAKING MOUNTING, STOPPING, AND DISMOUNTING A BREEZE.

MADE IN THE USA, DURABLE WITH ATTENTION TO EVERY DETAIL.

THE JANE OFFERS A SWIFT AND COMFORTABLE RIDE BONE-STOCK OR FULLY LOADED.

Endlessly customizable, accommodating geared hubs, front and rear racks, full fenders, chain guards, and up to 38mm wide tires.

The Jane can be fitted with hand operated caliper brakes, or the old-school feel of a coaster brake.

With a hand built frame and wheels, and sealed bearings used throughout, your Heritage is built for longevity.
